title: Tractor Revolutionizing Farm Efficiency
reason: The video describes the impact of using a tractor to improve food production for school meal programs.

tasks.task: Describe the efficiency increase provided by the new tractor.

subtasks.text: Note the new tractor can complete a task that previously took 45 minutes in just 45 seconds.
